description: Earthquake impact and hazard products: Afghanistan is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by REACH Initiative. On the 26th of October 2015, a large scale earthquake caused shelter damage throughout much of northern and central Afghanistan. During August 2016, the REACH Initiative (supported by ACTED, AfghanAid and People in Need) conducted a shelter response evaluation in 3 districts of Afghanistan on behalf of the Shelter Cluster. Coverage: Afghanistan. The portal lists 15 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher REACH Initiative. Its tags are damage assessment, earthquake-tsunami, shelter. It offers 2 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2019-11-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard and risk assessment. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
